info.title: Cuate API
info.description: The one owner of the contract between the clients and the server: every route, scope, event and payload. The server's routes and the client's calls are both tested against it (server/test/api.test.js). A payload key not declared here fails the test.

requestBody.description: The event data. A hook delivers it encrypted, as the jwe field of a signed envelope (docs/server.md, Hooks).
